sqliteSql: SELECT invoice_id,CASE WHEN days_overdue<=0 THEN '未逾期' WHEN days_overdue BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1—30' WHEN days_overdue<=60 THEN '31—60' WHEN days_overdue<=90 THEN '61—90' ELSE '90以上' END AS band FROM aging_mini WHERE balance_cents>0 ORDER BY invoice_id
